source: LeetCode algorithm metadata plus original BrainHub low-level design material

problems.title: Merge Strings Alternately
problems.summary: Interleave two strings one character at a time, appending the unused suffix of the longer input.
constraints: Inputs may be empty.
Preserve the order within each source string.

problems.title: Find Pivot Index
problems.summary: Return the first index whose left-side sum equals its right-side sum, excluding the value at the index.
constraints: Return -1 when no balance point exists.
Negative values are allowed.

problems.title: Is Subsequence
problems.summary: Determine whether every character of the first string appears in order inside the second string.
constraints: Characters need not be adjacent.
The empty string is a subsequence of every string.

problems.title: Valid Perfect Square
problems.summary: Decide whether an integer is the square of another integer without using floating-point square roots.
constraints: Negative values are not perfect squares.
Zero is a perfect square.

problems.title: Maximum Words in a Sentence
problems.summary: Given several space-delimited sentences, return the largest word count among them.
constraints: An empty collection has maximum zero.
Words are separated by ordinary whitespace.

problems.title: Check If a Double Exists
problems.summary: Report whether two different positions contain values where one is exactly twice the other.
constraints: The two positions must be distinct.
Zero needs two occurrences to pair with itself.

problems.title: Find the Added Character
problems.summary: One string is a shuffled copy of another with one extra character; return that extra character.
constraints: Characters may repeat.
The second input is exactly one character longer.

problems.title: Move Zeroes
problems.summary: Return the array with nonzero values kept in order and every zero moved to the end.
constraints: Preserve the relative order of nonzero values.
Return a transformed array for this practice version.

problems.title: Monotonic Array
problems.summary: Determine whether the sequence is entirely nondecreasing or entirely nonincreasing.
constraints: Equal adjacent values are allowed.
Arrays shorter than two values are monotonic.

problems.title: Shortest Degree-Preserving Subarray
problems.summary: Return the shortest contiguous length that has the same maximum frequency as the full array.
constraints: Return zero for an empty array in this practice version.
Ties use the shortest span.

problems.title: Sort Three Colors
problems.summary: Arrange an array containing only 0, 1, and 2 in ascending color order.
constraints: Return the arranged array.
Inputs contain only the three color codes.

problems.title: Longest Mountain
problems.summary: Find the longest contiguous run that strictly rises to one peak and then strictly falls.
constraints: A mountain needs at least three values.
Plateaus do not belong to a mountain.

problems.title: Find All Anagram Starts
problems.summary: Return every start index where a substring is a permutation of the pattern.
constraints: Return indexes in ascending order.
An empty or longer pattern has no matches.

problems.title: Count Subarrays With Target Sum
problems.summary: Count contiguous subarrays whose values add exactly to the target.
constraints: Values and the target may be negative.
Count overlapping subarrays separately.

problems.title: Continuous Multiple Sum
problems.summary: Determine whether a contiguous subarray of length at least two has a sum divisible by the divisor.
constraints: A zero divisor asks for an exact zero sum.
The chosen span must contain at least two values.

problems.title: Asteroid Collision
problems.summary: Simulate one-dimensional asteroids; opposite-moving neighbors collide and the smaller magnitude disappears.
constraints: Equal opposing magnitudes destroy both.
Return survivors in their final order.

problems.title: Decode Repeated String
problems.summary: Expand nested count[segment] expressions into their decoded string.
constraints: Repeat counts may contain multiple digits.
Encoded segments may be nested.

problems.title: K Closest Sorted Values
problems.summary: Choose the requested number of values nearest to a target and return those values sorted.
constraints: Break equal-distance ties toward the smaller value.
The input array is sorted.

problems.title: Minimum Positive Window
problems.summary: Return the shortest contiguous length whose positive values total at least the target.
constraints: Return zero when no qualifying window exists.
Input values are positive.

problems.title: Range Flight Bookings
problems.summary: Apply inclusive range seat additions and return the final reserved seats for every numbered flight.
constraints: Booking indexes are one-based.
Ranges include both endpoints.

problems.title: Car Pool Capacity
problems.summary: Given pickup and drop-off events along a route, decide whether passenger load ever exceeds capacity.
constraints: Passengers leave before new passengers board at the same location.
Trips use [passengers, start, end].

problems.title: Simplify Absolute Path
problems.summary: Normalize an absolute Unix-style path by resolving separators, current-directory markers, and parent-directory markers.
constraints: The result starts with one slash.
Parent navigation cannot move above root.

problems.title: Compare Version Numbers
problems.summary: Compare dot-separated numeric revisions after ignoring leading zeroes and missing trailing zero components.
constraints: Return -1, 0, or 1.
Each revision component is nonnegative.

problems.title: Count Windows With Bounded Maximum
problems.summary: Count contiguous subarrays whose maximum lies inside the inclusive lower and upper bounds.
constraints: Count each distinct index range.
The lower bound does not exceed the upper bound.

problems.title: Reduce Target From Array Ends
problems.summary: Remove values from either end until their sum equals the target, minimizing removals.
constraints: Return -1 when impossible.
Input values are positive.

problems.title: Bag of Tokens Score
problems.summary: Spend power on tokens for score or trade score for power to maximize the highest score reached.
constraints: Each token may be used once.
You may stop at any time.

problems.title: Stone Game VI
problems.summary: Two optimal players alternate selecting shared stones with player-specific values; report whether the first player wins, loses, or ties.
constraints: Return 1 for a first-player win, -1 for a loss, and 0 for a tie.
Both value arrays have equal length.

problems.title: Count Windows With K Odd Values
problems.summary: Count contiguous subarrays containing exactly the requested number of odd values.
constraints: Even values may appear anywhere.
The target is positive.

problems.title: Maximum Circular Subarray
problems.summary: Return the largest sum of a nonempty contiguous span when the array's end connects to its beginning.
constraints: Use each position at most once.
All-negative inputs choose their largest element.

problems.title: Longest Fixed-Difference Subsequence
problems.summary: Return the longest subsequence where every adjacent pair differs by the supplied amount.
constraints: Keep original index order.
The difference may be negative or zero.

problems.title: First Missing Positive
problems.summary: Return the smallest positive integer absent from the array.
constraints: Negative values and duplicates may appear.
The answer is at most length + 1.

problems.title: Candy Distribution
problems.summary: Assign at least one unit to each rating so higher-rated neighbors receive more, minimizing the total.
constraints: Only adjacent ratings impose comparisons.
Equal neighbors need no ordering.

problems.title: Text Justification
problems.summary: Pack words into fixed-width lines and distribute interior spaces as evenly as possible, leaving the last line left-aligned.
constraints: Earlier gaps receive extra spaces when division is uneven.
Every output line has exactly the requested width.

problems.title: Longest Valid Parentheses
problems.summary: Return the longest contiguous length that forms balanced parentheses.
constraints: Only '(' and ')' occur.
The empty string has result zero.

problems.title: Maximal Binary Rectangle
problems.summary: Find the largest axis-aligned rectangle containing only ones in a binary matrix.
constraints: Return area, not coordinates.
An empty matrix has area zero.

problems.title: Scramble String
problems.summary: Determine whether recursive binary splits and optional child swaps can transform the first string into the second.
constraints: Inputs must have equal length.
Characters may repeat.

problems.title: Stock Profit With Two Transactions
problems.summary: Return the best profit using at most two nonoverlapping buy-then-sell transactions.
constraints: Hold at most one share at a time.
Transactions are optional.

problems.title: Stock Profit With K Transactions
problems.summary: Return the best profit using at most the supplied number of buy-then-sell transactions.
constraints: A sale must follow its purchase.
Hold at most one share at a time.

problems.title: Minimum Dungeon Health
problems.summary: Find the minimum starting health needed to move right or down through a gain/loss grid while health always stays positive.
constraints: Start at the upper-left and finish at the lower-right.
Health may increase or decrease in each cell.

problems.title: Shortest Palindrome by Front Additions
problems.summary: Add the fewest characters to the front so the full string becomes a palindrome.
constraints: Return the resulting palindrome.
The empty string is already a palindrome.

problems.title: Count Smaller Values to the Right
problems.summary: For every position, count later values that are strictly smaller.
constraints: Equal values do not count.
Return one count per input position.

problems.title: Russian Doll Envelopes
problems.summary: Return the longest chain where both width and height strictly increase.
constraints: An envelope cannot rotate.
Equal widths cannot nest.

problems.title: Split Array Largest Sum
problems.summary: Split nonnegative values into exactly the requested number of nonempty contiguous parts while minimizing the largest part sum.
constraints: Preserve element order.
Every position belongs to exactly one part.

problems.title: Trapping Rain Water on a Grid
problems.summary: Compute water retained by a two-dimensional elevation map after rain.
constraints: Water may escape through every boundary cell.
Return total unit volume.

problems.title: Strange Printer
problems.summary: A printer can overwrite any contiguous interval with one repeated character; return the fewest turns needed for the target string.
constraints: Existing characters may be overwritten.
One turn prints only one character.

problems.title: K Inverse Pairs
problems.summary: Count permutations of 1 through n having exactly k inverse pairs, modulo 1,000,000,007.
constraints: An inverse pair has i < j and permutation[i] > permutation[j].
Return zero when k is unattainable.

problems.title: Ways to Return After Steps
problems.summary: Count step sequences that finish at index zero on a bounded line when each move goes left, stays, or goes right.
constraints: Never leave the array bounds.
Return the count modulo 1,000,000,007.

problems.title: Minimum Job Schedule Difficulty
problems.summary: Partition ordered jobs across consecutive nonempty days, minimizing the sum of each day's hardest job.
constraints: Job order cannot change.
Return -1 when there are fewer jobs than days.

problems.title: Maximum Team Performance
problems.summary: Choose at most k workers to maximize total speed multiplied by the team's minimum efficiency.
constraints: Speed and efficiency arrays align by worker.
Return the result modulo 1,000,000,007.

problems.title: Minimum Taps for a Garden
problems.summary: Each tap waters an interval around its position; return the fewest taps covering the full garden from zero through n.
constraints: Return -1 when complete coverage is impossible.
The ranges array has n + 1 entries.

problems.title: Palindrome Number
problems.summary: Decide whether a signed integer reads the same from left to right and right to left.
constraints: Negative values are not palindromes.
Do not ignore digits.

problems.title: Roman to Integer
problems.summary: Convert a valid Roman numeral into its integer value.
constraints: Subtractive pairs such as IV and CM are valid.
Input uses uppercase Roman symbols.

problems.title: Longest Common Prefix
problems.summary: Return the longest prefix shared by every string in the collection.
constraints: Return an empty string when no prefix is shared.
An empty collection has an empty prefix.

problems.title: First Substring Occurrence
problems.summary: Return the first index where the pattern occurs inside the text.
constraints: Return -1 when absent.
An empty pattern starts at index zero.

problems.title: Length of Last Word
problems.summary: Return the character count of the final whitespace-delimited word.
constraints: Leading and trailing spaces do not count.
The practice variant returns zero for all-whitespace input.

problems.title: Add Binary
problems.summary: Add two binary strings and return the normalized binary sum.
constraints: Inputs contain only zero and one.
The result has no unnecessary leading zeroes.

problems.title: Integer Square Root
problems.summary: Return the greatest integer whose square does not exceed the nonnegative input.
constraints: Discard any fractional part.
Use integer-safe arithmetic.

problems.title: Pascal's Triangle
problems.summary: Generate the requested number of Pascal rows, where each interior value is the sum above it.
constraints: Rows are returned from top to bottom.
The first row contains one.

problems.title: Majority Element
problems.summary: Return the value appearing more than half the time.
constraints: A majority value is guaranteed.
Values may be negative.

problems.title: Isomorphic Strings
problems.summary: Check whether characters in the first string can map one-to-one onto characters in the second while preserving order.
constraints: A source character always maps to the same target.
Two source characters cannot share one target.

problems.title: Zigzag Conversion
problems.summary: Write characters down and diagonally across rows, then read the rows in order.
constraints: One row returns the original string.
Keep every character exactly once.

problems.title: String to Integer
problems.summary: Parse optional leading whitespace and sign followed by decimal digits, clamping to signed 32-bit range.
constraints: Parsing stops at the first non-digit after the numeric prefix.
Return zero when no numeric prefix exists.

problems.title: Integer to Roman
problems.summary: Encode an integer using standard subtractive Roman numeral notation.
constraints: Input lies between 1 and 3999.
Use uppercase symbols.

problems.title: Three Sum Closest
problems.summary: Choose three values whose sum has minimum absolute distance from the target.
constraints: At least three values are provided.
Ties choose the smaller sum in this practice variant.

problems.title: Four Sum
problems.summary: Return every unique sorted quadruple that adds to the target.
constraints: Do not repeat equivalent quadruples.
Return quadruples in lexicographic order.

problems.title: Next Permutation
problems.summary: Return the lexicographically next arrangement, wrapping to ascending order after the greatest arrangement.
constraints: Preserve duplicate values.
Return a transformed copy for this practice version.

problems.title: First and Last Target Position
problems.summary: Return the inclusive first and last indexes of a target in sorted values.
constraints: Return [-1,-1] when absent.
The input is nondecreasing.

problems.title: Count and Say
problems.summary: Build the nth term by describing consecutive runs in the previous decimal string.
constraints: The first term is 1.
Read runs from left to right.

problems.title: Spiral Matrix II
problems.summary: Fill a square matrix with consecutive integers in clockwise spiral order.
constraints: Start with one at the upper-left.
Return an n by n matrix.

problems.title: Unique Paths With Obstacles
problems.summary: Count right-and-down paths from the upper-left to lower-right while avoiding blocked cells.
constraints: One marks a blocked cell.
A blocked endpoint yields zero.

problems.title: Minimum Path Sum
problems.summary: Find the minimum right-and-down path sum from upper-left to lower-right.
constraints: Every visited cell contributes its value.
Values are nonnegative.

problems.title: Combinations
problems.summary: Return all increasing selections of k distinct integers from 1 through n.
constraints: Each combination is ascending.
Return combinations in lexicographic order.

problems.title: Keep At Most Two Duplicates
problems.summary: Return the sorted sequence after retaining no more than two copies of each value.
constraints: Input is sorted.
Relative order is unchanged.

problems.title: Search Rotated Array With Duplicates
problems.summary: Determine whether the target occurs in a rotated nondecreasing array that may contain duplicates.
constraints: Return a boolean.
The array may be empty.

problems.title: Gray Code
problems.summary: Return the canonical reflected Gray-code sequence for the requested bit width.
constraints: Begin with zero.
Adjacent values differ by one bit.

problems.title: Restore IP Addresses
problems.summary: Insert three dots to form every valid IPv4 address represented by the digit string.
constraints: Each segment is 0 through 255.
Leading zeroes are forbidden except for zero itself.

problems.title: Unique Binary Search Trees
problems.summary: Count structurally distinct binary search trees storing values 1 through n.
constraints: Only tree shape matters.
The empty tree count is one in this practice variant.

problems.title: Triangle Minimum Path
problems.summary: Choose adjacent values down a triangle to minimize the top-to-bottom sum.
constraints: From column j move to j or j+1.
Rows grow by one value.

problems.title: Stock Profit With Unlimited Transactions
problems.summary: Return maximum profit using any number of nonoverlapping buy-then-sell transactions.
constraints: Hold at most one share.
Transactions are optional.

problems.title: Single Number II
problems.summary: Find the value occurring once when every other value occurs exactly three times.
constraints: Values may be negative.
One singleton is guaranteed.

problems.title: Reverse Words
problems.summary: Reverse the order of whitespace-delimited words and normalize gaps to single spaces.
constraints: Remove leading and trailing whitespace.
Do not reverse characters inside a word.

problems.title: Find First Peak
problems.summary: Return the first index strictly greater than its existing neighbors.
constraints: Adjacent values differ.
This practice variant chooses the first valid peak.

problems.title: Maximum Sorted Gap
problems.summary: Return the largest difference between adjacent values after sorting.
constraints: Return zero for fewer than two values.
Values are integers.

problems.title: Factorial Trailing Zeroes
problems.summary: Count trailing zeroes in n factorial without constructing the factorial.
constraints: Each zero is formed by a factor pair 2 and 5.
The input is nonnegative.

problems.title: Largest Concatenated Number
problems.summary: Arrange nonnegative integers so their decimal concatenation is as large as possible.
constraints: Return a string.
All-zero input returns one zero.

problems.title: Repeated DNA Sequences
problems.summary: Return every length-ten substring appearing more than once in the DNA string.
constraints: Input uses A, C, G, and T.
Return matches in lexicographic order.

problems.title: Range Bitwise AND
problems.summary: Return the bitwise AND of every integer in the inclusive range.
constraints: Both bounds are nonnegative.
The left bound does not exceed the right.

problems.title: Count Primes
problems.summary: Count prime numbers strictly smaller than the limit.
constraints: Zero and one are not prime.
The upper bound is excluded.

problems.title: Maximal Square
problems.summary: Return the area of the largest all-one square in a binary matrix.
constraints: Return area rather than side length.
An empty matrix returns zero.

problems.title: Combined Rectangle Area
problems.summary: Return the union area of two axis-aligned rectangles.
constraints: Each rectangle has positive width and height.
Subtract overlap exactly once.

problems.title: Concatenated Word Starts
problems.summary: Return every index where a substring is a concatenation of all equal-width words in any order.
constraints: Use every supplied word exactly once.
Return indexes in ascending order.

problems.title: Wildcard Matching
problems.summary: Match the entire text against a pattern where question mark matches one character and star matches any sequence.
constraints: The complete text must match.
Star may match an empty sequence.

problems.title: N-Queens Count
problems.summary: Count placements of n queens where no two share a row, column, or diagonal.
constraints: One queen is placed in every row.
Rotations and reflections count separately.

problems.title: K-th Permutation Sequence
problems.summary: Return the one-indexed kth lexicographic permutation of the digits 1 through n.
constraints: The requested position is valid.
Each digit appears once.

problems.title: Valid Number
problems.summary: Decide whether the entire trimmed string is a valid decimal number with an optional exponent.
constraints: An exponent must contain an integer.
At least one mantissa digit is required.

problems.title: Minimum Palindrome Cuts
problems.summary: Return the fewest cuts needed to partition the string into palindromic pieces.
constraints: A palindrome needs no cut.
The empty string needs zero cuts.

problems.title: Maximum Collinear Points
problems.summary: Return the greatest number of points lying on one infinite straight line.
constraints: Duplicate coordinates are counted.
Vertical lines are valid.

problems.title: Minimum in Rotated Array II
problems.summary: Return the minimum value in a rotated sorted array that may contain duplicates.
constraints: At least one value is present.
The original ordering was nondecreasing.

problems.title: Building Skyline
problems.summary: Return critical x-coordinates where the maximum active building height changes.
constraints: Buildings are [left,right,height].
Do not emit consecutive points with equal height.

problems.title: Nearby Almost Duplicate
problems.summary: Determine whether two positions are close enough in both index and value.
constraints: Index distance and value distance are inclusive.
The positions must differ.

problems.title: Basic Calculator
problems.summary: Evaluate an integer expression containing addition, subtraction, parentheses, and whitespace.
constraints: Unary signs are allowed.
Division and multiplication are absent.

problems.title: Count Digit One
problems.summary: Count how many digit ones appear across all nonnegative integers up to n.
constraints: Include both endpoints.
Leading zeroes are not written.

problems.title: Integer to English Words
problems.summary: Write a nonnegative integer in canonical American English words.
constraints: Use Billion, Million, Thousand, and Hundred groups.
Do not use the word and.

problems.title: Remove Invalid Parentheses
problems.summary: Remove the fewest parentheses needed to produce every valid result.
constraints: Keep non-parenthesis characters.
Return unique results in lexicographic order.

problems.title: Count Range Sums
problems.summary: Count contiguous ranges whose sum lies inside the inclusive lower and upper bounds.
constraints: Values and bounds may be negative.
Count each index range separately.

problems.title: Patching Array
problems.summary: Add the fewest positive values so every sum from one through n can be formed from a subset.
constraints: Input values are positive and sorted.
Each value may be used once.

problems.title: Max Rectangle Sum At Most K
problems.summary: Return the greatest rectangular submatrix sum that does not exceed k.
constraints: At least one valid rectangle exists.
Rectangles are axis-aligned and nonempty.

problems.title: Frog Jump
problems.summary: Determine whether jumps of k-1, k, or k+1 can reach the last stone after a jump of k.
constraints: The first jump must be one.
Stone positions are strictly increasing.

problems.title: Strong Password Checker
problems.summary: Return the fewest insertions, deletions, or replacements needed for a strong password.
constraints: Strong length is 6 through 20.
Require lowercase, uppercase, digit, and no run of three identical characters.

problems.title: Arithmetic Subsequences
problems.summary: Count arithmetic subsequences containing at least three values.
constraints: Keep original index order.
Subsequences need not be contiguous.

problems.title: Reverse Pairs
problems.summary: Count index pairs i before j where the earlier value is greater than twice the later value.
constraints: Use strict greater-than.
Values may be negative.

problems.title: Freedom Trail
problems.summary: Rotate a circular character ring in either direction and press to spell the key with minimum steps.
constraints: One press is required per key character.
Every key character occurs on the ring.

problems.title: Student Attendance Record II
problems.summary: Count length-n records with fewer than two absences and no three consecutive late days.
constraints: Each day is present, absent, or late.

problems.title: Integers Without Consecutive Ones
problems.summary: Count integers from zero through n whose binary form has no adjacent one bits.
constraints: Include zero and n when valid.
Leading zeroes are irrelevant.

problems.title: Course Schedule III
problems.summary: Choose the maximum number of courses, each requiring consecutive duration before its deadline.
constraints: Only one course runs at a time.
Courses may be reordered.

problems.title: K-th Multiplication Table Value
problems.summary: Return the kth smallest entry in an m by n multiplication table.
constraints: Rows and columns are one-indexed factors.
Duplicate products occupy separate positions.

problems.title: Twenty Four Game
problems.summary: Determine whether four values can make 24 using binary arithmetic operations and parentheses.
constraints: Use each value exactly once.
Division is real-valued.

problems.title: K-th Pair Distance
problems.summary: Sort all absolute distances between index pairs and return the kth smallest.
constraints: Positions must differ.
Duplicate distances count separately.

problems.title: Couples Holding Hands
problems.summary: Return the minimum swaps needed so every adjacent seat pair contains partners numbered x and x xor one.
constraints: Each person appears once.
Swap any two seated people.

problems.title: Minimum Swaps for Increasing Sequences
problems.summary: Swap values at matching indexes in two arrays so both become strictly increasing, minimizing swaps.
constraints: A valid result is guaranteed.
A swap exchanges values only at one shared index.

problems.title: Design an LRU Cache
problems.summary: Evict the least recently accessed entry when a fixed-capacity key/value cache becomes full.
constraints: Supported protocol: init(capacity), put(key,value), get(key).
Return one integer per operation; use -1 for operations without a value.
Operation names and argument rows align by index.

problems.title: Design an LFU Cache
problems.summary: Evict the least frequently used entry, breaking frequency ties by least recent access.
constraints: Supported protocol: init(capacity), put(key,value), get(key).
Return one integer per operation; use -1 for operations without a value.
Operation names and argument rows align by index.

problems.title: Design a TTL Cache
problems.summary: Store values with absolute expiry times and make expired entries unreadable.
constraints: Supported protocol: put(key,value,expires), get(key,now), purge(now).
Return one integer per operation; use -1 for operations without a value.
Operation names and argument rows align by index.

problems.title: Design a Fixed-Window Rate Limiter
problems.summary: Allow at most a configured number of requests per user in each fixed time window.
constraints: Supported protocol: allow(user,time,limit,window).
Return one integer per operation; use -1 for operations without a value.
Operation names and argument rows align by index.

problems.title: Design a Sliding-Window Rate Limiter
problems.summary: Limit each user by counting accepted requests in the immediately preceding time window.
constraints: Supported protocol: allow(user,time,limit,window).
Return one integer per operation; use -1 for operations without a value.
Operation names and argument rows align by index.

problems.title: Design a Token Bucket
problems.summary: Refill tokens over elapsed time and consume one token per accepted request.
constraints: Supported protocol: allow(user,time,capacity,refillRate).
Return one integer per operation; use -1 for operations without a value.
Operation names and argument rows align by index.

problems.title: Design a Leaky Bucket
problems.summary: Drain queued work over time and reject requests when the bounded bucket is full.
constraints: Supported protocol: allow(user,time,capacity,leakRate).
Return one integer per operation; use -1 for operations without a value.
Operation names and argument rows align by index.

problems.title: Design a Hit Counter
problems.summary: Record timestamped hits and count only those in the trailing 300-second interval.
constraints: Supported protocol: hit(time), get(time).
Return one integer per operation; use -1 for operations without a value.
Operation names and argument rows align by index.

problems.title: Design a Moving Average
problems.summary: Return the floor of the average across the most recent bounded window of values.
constraints: Supported protocol: init(size), next(value).
Return one integer per operation; use -1 for operations without a value.
Operation names and argument rows align by index.

problems.title: Design a Median Finder
problems.summary: Accept streamed integers and return the lower median of all values seen so far.
constraints: Supported protocol: add(value), median().
Return one integer per operation; use -1 for operations without a value.
Operation names and argument rows align by index.

problems.title: Design a Min Stack
problems.summary: Support stack operations plus constant-behavior minimum queries.
constraints: Supported protocol: push(value), pop(), top(), min().
Return one integer per operation; use -1 for operations without a value.
Operation names and argument rows align by index.

problems.title: Design a Max Stack
problems.summary: Support stack operations, maximum lookup, and removal of the top-most maximum.
constraints: Supported protocol: push(value), pop(), top(), peekMax(), popMax().
Return one integer per operation; use -1 for operations without a value.
Operation names and argument rows align by index.

problems.title: Design a Queue Using Stacks
problems.summary: Provide first-in-first-out behavior through a queue API.
constraints: Supported protocol: push(value), dequeue(), peek(), empty().
Return one integer per operation; use -1 for operations without a value.
Operation names and argument rows align by index.

problems.title: Design a Stack Using Queues
problems.summary: Provide last-in-first-out behavior through a stack API.
constraints: Supported protocol: push(value), pop(), top(), empty().
Return one integer per operation; use -1 for operations without a value.
Operation names and argument rows align by index.

problems.title: Design a Circular Queue
problems.summary: Implement a fixed-capacity queue with front, rear, empty, and full queries.
constraints: Supported protocol: init(capacity), enQueue(value), deQueue(), Front(), Rear(), isEmpty(), isFull().
Return one integer per operation; use -1 for operations without a value.
Operation names and argument rows align by index.

problems.title: Design a Circular Deque
problems.summary: Implement fixed-capacity insertion and deletion at both ends.
